source_expressions.RD4-F058: \boxed{\begin{aligned}\mathcal I_n&=(\mathcal C_n,\mathcal X_n)\\\mathcal S_n&=(\mathcal I_n,\mathcal G_n,\mathcal V_n)\\\mathcal L_{i,n}&=Review_{b_i}(\mathcal I_n,\mathcal P_n^{dispatch})\\(\mathcal G_n^{r0},\mathcal Q_n,\mathcal D_n^{prop},\Theta_{n+1})&=\mathscr R_0(\mathcal S_n,\{\mathcal L_{i,n}\},\mathcal L_n^{dissent})\\\mathcal Y_n&=ProposeResponses(\mathcal G_n^{r0},\mathcal D_n^{prop})\\(\mathcal G_n^{r1},\mathcal Req_n)&=\mathscr R_1(\mathcal S_n,\mathcal G_n^{r0},\mathcal Y_n)\\\mathcal C_{n+1}&=ApplyAuthorizedRoutes(\mathcal C_n,\mathcal G_n^{r1},\mathcal Y_n)\\\mathcal P_n^{assure}&=PlanAssurance(\mathcal G_n^{r1},\mathcal C_{n+1})\\(\mathcal G_n^{r2},\mathcal CloseReq_n)&=\mathscr R_2(\mathcal G_n^{r1},\mathcal C_{n+1},\mathcal O_n^{tech},\mathcal O_n^{repro},\mathcal O_n^{audit})\\Closure_n&=ReviewAuthorizedClosure(\mathcal G_n^{r2},\mathcal CloseReq_n)\\\mathcal X_{n+1}&=AdvanceContext(\mathcal X_n,ContextEvents_n)\\\mathcal V_{n+1}&=AppendEvents(\mathcal V_n,EventBatch_n)\\\mathcal G_{n+1}&=DeriveGraph(\mathcal V_{n+1},EligibleEvidence_n)\\\mathbf z_{n+1}&=AssessResilience(\mathcal C_{n+1},\mathcal X_{n+1},\mathcal G_{n+1})\\Next_n&\in\{STOP\_SAFELY,ROTATE\_AND\_CONTINUE,CONVERGED\_FOR\_AUTHORIZED\_DECISION\}\end{aligned}}

global_semantics.state: State folds ordered append-only events; any cache requires its source-event digest. No cache is authority.
global_semantics.calibration: Profile-chosen constants are policy hypotheses, not measured calibration. Ordinal ordering only until interval/ratio calibration supports arithmetic.
global_semantics.authority: Scores never close findings, approve, activate or grant authority.
global_semantics.unknown: Unknown nonrequired values remain visible. Required unknown predicates add applicable missing-evidence/calibration requirements.
global_semantics.blockers: Blockers scope affected operations; STOP_SAFELY does not globally halt safe unrelated development.
global_semantics.expiry: Expiry/revocation appends reopening events through an authorized service and reevaluates closure/activation; no background monitor is implemented.
global_semantics.sensitivity: Finite enumeration, interval proof, symbolic analysis or bounded sampling may assess Omega. Sampling covers assessed samples only, not a continuous-domain proof.
global_semantics.fixtures: Any examples are synthetic, not measurements.

profile_constants.selection: Explicit profile selection; no numerical defaults or measured calibration asserted.

symbols.n: Nonnegative review iteration; i indexes active bearings, f/g findings, e evidence, h independence dimensions, j assessment components, d resilience dimensions.
symbols.C: C_n candidate manifest; C_n^reviewed and C_n^current bound snapshots; C_{n+1} candidate after authorized routes.
symbols.X: X_n review context; ContextEvents_n explicit applicable context changes.
symbols.I: I_n=(C_n,X_n), immutable review input pair for an iteration.
symbols.G: G_n directed typed claim/finding multigraph; G_n^{r0,r1,r2} staged reconciliations; Dep(f) bound dependencies.
symbols.V: V_n ordered append-only event sequence; EventBatch_n ordered events; source-event digest required for cache.
symbols.F: F_n findings; F_n^crit open critical findings without authorized boundary; Critical, Open and AuthorizedBoundary typed predicates.
symbols.R: R_n^conf typed conflict edges between findings.
symbols.Theta: Theta_n finite active bearings; tuple b_i identity, theta_i angle, w_{i,n} nonnegative weight, parent_i lineage, expiry_i validity, mode_i replace/supplement; k_n size.
symbols.L: L_{i,n} review lane output; L_n^dissent dedicated dissent output.
symbols.independence: i_{i,n} eight coordinates: actor, model, prompt, evidence, environment, procedure, organization, custody; each calibrated [0,1] or unknown; K_i^ind critical dimensions.
symbols.iota: Optional weighted independence summary; alpha_h>=0, sum alpha_h=1.
symbols.mu: mu_{i,n} lane visualization magnitude or mu_{f,n} finding magnitude; distinct indexed families, calibrated nonnegative scales before arithmetic.
symbols.T: T_n tension; c_n(f,g) assessed conflict coefficient in [0,1]; T_max profile threshold.
symbols.coverage: c_{i,n} bearing coverage in [0,1] or unknown; kappa_n weighted coverage; K_n^bear nonempty critical bearings; kappa_n^crit minimum.
symbols.weights: w_{i,n} active nonnegative bearing weights; pi_{i,n+1} nonnegative proposed priorities; Fallback profile preserve_prior/balanced.
symbols.risk: u_{f,n}=(s_f,p_f,x_f,nu_f) severity, probability, exposure and uncertainty; primarily an ordered risk vector, not a product.
symbols.resources: r_n resources including r_n^used,r_n^limit; B_n^resource applicable resource blockers.
symbols.evidence: e evidence; Status, Applicable, BindingsCurrent, Disputed predicates; EligibleEvidence_n set of eligible evidence at iteration n.
symbols.memory: Lambda(e) lineage group lambda; M_lambda,n capped memory aggregate; gamma_e,q_e,a_e,r_e,b_e calibrated contribution, quality, applicability, recency, binding factors; M_lambda^cap cap. r_e is not resource vector r_n.
symbols.health: Legacy symbol key retained for compatibility: denotes known uncertainty, not health. See uncertainty.
symbols.uncertainty: h_j known uncertainty on the explicitly declared profile scale, or unknown; no domain/calibration invented. J_known,J_unknown partition J_all; omega_j nonnegative weights; H_n^known weighted known uncertainty; eta_n^unknown unknown weight fraction. Source heading: Uncertainty and Adequacy.
symbols.gates: G_{f,stage}^required applicable gate set, g in PASS/FAIL/unknown/not_assessed; Ready does not imply applicability or authority.
symbols.novelty: j_n=(j_new,j_conflict,j_assumption,j_reopen,j_evidence); J_n=lambda^T j_n normalized novelty when calibrated; bold lambda coefficients differ from lineage label lambda.
symbols.z: z_n 13-vector in ([0,1] union {unknown})^13; Z_n weighted geometric aggregate; Z_n^floor critical minimum.
symbols.D: D_n^required required resilience dimensions; D_n^crit nonempty critical resilience dimensions; D_n^prop proposed dispositions (not a dimension set).
symbols.Y: Y_n proposed responses, not authorized actions.
symbols.Req: Req_n requirements after second reconciliation; CloseReq_n closure requirements; U_n^assure,U_n^close explicit unsatisfied requirements.
symbols.A: A_n^chg change authorization; A_n^disp disposition authorization, distinct operation-specific capabilities.
symbols.assurance: P_n^assure assurance DAG; O_n^tech technical verification, O_n^repro reproduction, O_n^audit independent audit evidence.
symbols.Closure: Closure_n authorized closure assessment, never inferred from metrics.
symbols.Delta: Delta_n^id manifest identity change indicator; Delta_{f,n}^impact dependency-impact indicator.
symbols.B: B_n active blocker set scoped to affected operations; active(b,n) lifecycle predicate.
symbols.Continue: Continue_n Boolean when all applicable predicates known; unknown requires evidence/calibration rather than false.
symbols.Next: Next_n in STOP_SAFELY, ROTATE_AND_CONTINUE, CONVERGED_FOR_AUTHORIZED_DECISION; no automatic approval.
symbols.window: WindowSatisfied_n normalized J below epsilon_J for configured consecutive W_J observations; missing history is unknown.
symbols.sensitivity: SensitivityStable_n Boolean for assessed pairs (omega,epsilon),(omega',epsilon') in configured Omega; epsilon denotes assessed threshold parameters including epsilon_J.
symbols.checkpoint: c checkpoint; Rebind,BlockersCleared,EvidenceRevalidated,BudgetRestored,TransitionValid explicit predicates; resume pending_requirement or blocked_from_state.
symbols.RD: Reconciliation deliberation role; recommendation only, not executing service.
symbols.conceptual: ResilienceEvidence, AnalyticalDiversity, SequentialReconciliation, EvidenceBinding, ReversibleHistory, RotatedRetesting qualitative concepts.
symbols.roles: Orchestration, Reconciliation, Implementation, Verification, Reproduction, Audit, Approval, Authority distinct institutional roles.
symbols.functions: Findings,ConflictEdges,Diff,AdvanceContext,AppendEvents,Review,DissentReview,ResourceBlockers,ProposeResponses,MaterializeChangeSet,AuthorizeChange,Apply,PlanAssurance,AuthorizeDisposition,ReviewClosure,ApplyAuthorizedRoutes,ReviewAuthorizedClosure,DeriveGraph,AssessResilience are proposed typed operations; script R_0,R_1,R_2 staged reconciliation, not physics laws.

formulas.name: conflict_edges

formulas.name: changed_manifest

formulas.name: input_and_state
formulas.conditions: Structural correspondence only: core.candidate and core.record bind local manifests/envelopes; neither implements this review state or equations.

formulas.name: context_advance
formulas.conditions: Explicit applicable context events; no implicit context mutation.

formulas.name: event_append
formulas.conditions: Ordered append only; state folds events and caches require source-event digest.

formulas.name: bearing_set
formulas.conditions: Finite set; expiry and parent lineage explicit; replacement never erases history.

formulas.name: bearing_admission
formulas.conditions: Every predicate assessed; unknown does not admit.

formulas.name: review_lane
formulas.conditions: Dispatch is not an assurance plan or authority.

formulas.name: dissent_lane
formulas.conditions: Dedicated dissent survives reconciliation; no majority erasure.

formulas.name: independence_vector
formulas.conditions: Eight distinct dimensions; unknown values not omitted; without critical dimensions independence is not_assessed.

formulas.name: independence_floor
formulas.conditions: Only defined with nonempty critical set, known critical values and justified scales; unknown critical prevents passing floor.

formulas.name: optional_independence_summary
formulas.conditions: Optional; arithmetic only after scale calibration, never a replacement for vector/floor.

formulas.name: bearing_visualization
formulas.conditions: Visualization only, no chart here; cancellation never erases source findings.

formulas.name: tension
formulas.conditions: No assessed findings: not_applicable. Zero denominator: undefined, not zero. Unknown coefficients propagate; calibrated magnitude scales required.

formulas.name: bearing_coverage
formulas.conditions: Positive active-weight denominator; unknown coverage not dropped; no active bearings is not_assessed.

formulas.name: critical_bearing_coverage
formulas.conditions: Nonempty critical set and positive active weights required; unknown critical bearing prevents known passing floor.

formulas.name: weight_update
formulas.conditions: k_n>0; nonnegative priorities; compatible active membership; changed membership requires explicit redistribution; absent fallback undefined.

formulas.name: risk_vector
formulas.conditions: Primarily vector/ordinal ordering. Product only with calibrated ratio scales, never inferred from notation.

formulas.name: resource_blockers
formulas.conditions: Limits and usage bound to operation; unknown usage is not evidence of restored budget.

formulas.name: eligible_evidence
formulas.conditions: All predicates known; expired/revoked/disputed evidence ineligible, unknown not eligible.

formulas.name: lineage_memory
formulas.conditions: Contribution scales/provenance lineage grouping calibrated first; otherwise ordered ledger authoritative and no aggregate, including no inferred zero from empty evidence.

formulas.name: known_uncertainty
formulas.conditions: No known positive weight: unknown; report unknown fraction separately; calibrated interval/ratio scales required. Source is known uncertainty, not a health score.

formulas.name: unknown_fraction
formulas.conditions: Empty/zero total: undefined/not_assessed, not 0; nonnegative valid weights and full partition required.

formulas.name: stage_readiness
formulas.conditions: Empty required set does not grant approval; applicability and authorization separate; unknown is not PASS.

formulas.name: novelty
formulas.conditions: Normalize only under explicit profile calibration; missing component/history propagates unknown.

formulas.name: resilience_vector
formulas.conditions: Existing proposed 13-dimensional ordering explicit; unknown nonrequired dimensions visible.

formulas.name: resilience_aggregate
formulas.conditions: Both branches only when all required values known, required set nonempty, valid nonnegative weights and positive required total; log branch requires positive z. Calibrated scales; no inferred zero with other required unknowns.

formulas.name: critical_resilience_floor
formulas.conditions: Critical set nonempty; unknown critical prevents known passing floor; metrics never close findings or grant authority.

formulas.name: initial_reconciliation
formulas.conditions: Q_n explicit initial-reconciliation requirements/work queue, not an ambiguous queue or approval.

formulas.name: propose_responses
formulas.conditions: Proposed responses only; no mutation or approval.

formulas.name: response_reconciliation
formulas.conditions: Preserve unresolved requirements and dissent.

formulas.name: disposition_routes
formulas.conditions: FIXED is a proposed mutating route, not proof of implementation/closure; invalid or unknown disposition blocks affected route.

formulas.name: materialize_change
formulas.conditions: Explicit bound change set; proposal cannot authorize itself.

formulas.name: authorize_change
formulas.conditions: External operation-specific authority; no score grants it.

formulas.name: apply_change
formulas.conditions: Only authorized bound changes; stale/unknown binding prevents apply.

formulas.name: nonmutating_candidate
formulas.latex: C_{n+1}=C_n\quad\text{for a nonmutating route unless another authorized change applies}
formulas.conditions: Nonmutating disposition still needs separate disposition authority/evidence.

formulas.name: assurance_plan
formulas.conditions: Explicit DAG with verification, reproduction and audit separated; planning is not execution.

formulas.name: assurance_reconciliation
formulas.conditions: Missing/disputed/currentness failures remain requirements; technical verification is not reproduction or audit.

formulas.name: authorize_disposition
formulas.conditions: Separate from change authorization, externally bound to disposition and requirements.

formulas.name: review_closure
formulas.conditions: No direct reconciliation mutation; authorized service persists accepted closure.

formulas.name: identity_change
formulas.conditions: core.digest implements canonical SHA-256 only; this review predicate remains planned; missing manifest is unknown.

formulas.name: finding_impact
formulas.conditions: Dependency completeness required; unknown dependencies cannot imply no impact.

formulas.name: active_blockers
formulas.conditions: Blockers scope affected operations, not all safe development; preserve reason/owner/resume target.

formulas.name: unsatisfied_requirements
formulas.conditions: Explicit requirements; unknown satisfaction remains unsatisfied for convergence, not silently omitted.

formulas.name: novelty_window
formulas.conditions: Configured positive integer W_J and epsilon_J; enough assessed consecutive history and normalization calibration required; empty/missing window unknown.

formulas.name: continuation
formulas.conditions: Applicable required unknown predicates cannot imply convergence: add missing-evidence/calibration requirement; no uncalibrated threshold comparison.

formulas.name: next_status
formulas.conditions: Converged is not approved; only known predicates select convergence; stop scopes blocked operations.

formulas.name: resume
formulas.conditions: Resume at pending_requirement or blocked_from_state; all predicates required and known; expiry/revocation appends reopening through authorized service, no background monitor.

formulas.name: sensitivity_stability
formulas.conditions: Finite enumeration, interval proof, symbolic analysis, bounded sampling supported as proposed methods; sampling only assessed samples not continuous proof; empty assessment not stable. Compare fixed base predicate snapshots to avoid self-referential evaluation.

formulas.name: deliberation_no_authority
formulas.conditions: Institutional prohibition, not a measured numeric score or executable permission check.

formulas.name: deliberation_recommendations
formulas.conditions: One denotes permitted recommendation role, not authority; reopening recommendation persisted by authorized service, not direct mutation.

formulas.name: conceptual_resilience
formulas.conditions: Conceptual noncomputable relation; no calibrated multiplication, causal law or measurement claim.

formulas.name: institutional_separation
formulas.conditions: All institutional roles distinct, not merely adjacent inequality; separation does not itself prove independence.

formulas.name: graph_derivation
formulas.conditions: Event fold with source-event digest for cache; evidence eligibility explicitly bound and reevaluated for expiry/revocation before reuse.

formulas.name: resilience_assessment
formulas.conditions: All 13 dimensions explicit; unknown retained; no invented calibrated scoring.

formulas.name: composite_transition
formulas.conditions: ApplyAuthorizedRoutes expands materialization, separately authorized mutating application and nonmutating identity; ReviewAuthorizedClosure expands separate disposition authorization and closure review. Unknown required predicates preclude convergence; no scheduler/evaluator implemented; sensitivity uses noncircular base snapshots.
